line_items.description: Emergency 400-Pack Squeaky Neon Rubber Ducks (Mascot Load-Testing Fleet)
Boutique USB-C Soldering Iron TS80P (Silver Pro Edition)
Office Air-Revival Monster Ficus (Rental & Staging Deposit)

reasoning: The note names the quarterly hackathon and states the purchase was pre-approved under the team event budget, so the rubber-duck giveaways, the booth-staging gaffer tape, and the soldering irons bought as event hardware are event materials reimbursed in full; the soldering irons are also tools with a €99.00 unit price, below the €100.00 threshold at which an IT Helpdesk ticket would be required. The Monster Ficus line is temporary staging greenery rented for that named, pre-approved event, so the staging exception in Chapter 10 overrides the general plant exclusion and the line is reimbursed with the other event materials, together with its VAT. Nothing is deducted, so the invoice is approved in full.
